description.en:
Sets the same two brightness-related display flags as CMND_BRIGHT_SWAP, on both screens at once.
Exactly what the flags change on screen was not identified. It is never called by the shipped scripts.
First flag, applied to both screens (bits 9 and 10).
Second flag, applied to both screens (bits 11 and 12).

1.0 once the flags were set, 0.0 if the display controller was missing.
null if the engine is not ready or no argument was given.

examples.case: Setting both flags on both screens (not found in script_clean/; invented)
examples.code:
// Same as calling CMND_BRIGHT_SWAP on the top and bottom screens
CMND_BRIGHT_SWAP_ALL(true, true);
